\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 215-218 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R223-first-pass-words-from-chapters-215-218}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a thorn and a crop.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item today's, yesterday's, tomorrow's, true, uncertain
  \item bald, bearded, charming, worn out, wakeful
  \item a roof tile, a furnace, a litter, a vehicle, a chariot
  \item a pace, a witness, a defendant, a punishment, a charge
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Today's? (\textbf{hodiernus, hodierna, hodiernum}.) Yesterday's? (\textbf{hesternus, hesterna, hesternum}.) Tomorrow's? (\textbf{crāstinus, crāstina, crāstinum}.) True? (\textbf{vērus, vēra, vērum}.) Uncertain? (\textbf{incertus, incerta, incertum}.) Bald? (\textbf{calvus, calva, calvum}.) Bearded? (\textbf{barbātus, barbāta, barbātum}.) Charming? (\textbf{venustus, venusta, venustum}.) Worn out? (\textbf{dēfessus, dēfessa, dēfessum}.) Wakeful? (\textbf{vigil, vigilis}.) A roof tile? (\textbf{tēgula, tēgulae}.) A furnace? (\textbf{fornāx, fornācis}.) A litter? (\textbf{lectīca, lectīcae}.) A vehicle? (\textbf{vehiculum, vehiculī}.) A chariot? (\textbf{currus, currūs}.) A pace? (\textbf{passus, passūs}.) A witness? (\textbf{testis, testis}.) A defendant? (\textbf{reus, reī}.) A punishment? (\textbf{poena, poenae}.) A charge? (\textbf{crīmen, crīminis}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 219-223 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R223-second-pass-words-from-chapters-219-223}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for reputation and a messenger; news.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item reputation, a messenger; news, a show, an actor, a story
  \item a maidservant, a freedman, a newcomer, a young person, a widow
  \item a rule, a difference; a crisis, an outcome, fortune, an accident
  \item gold, silver, bronze; money, iron, the metal lead
  \item mist, a breeze, a root, a thorn, a crop
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Reputation? (\textbf{fāma, fāmae}.) A messenger; news? (\textbf{nūntius, nūntiī}.) A show? (\textbf{spectāculum, spectāculī}.) An actor? (\textbf{histriō, histriōnis}.) A story? (\textbf{fābula, fābulae}.) A maidservant? (\textbf{ancilla, ancillae}.) A freedman? (\textbf{lībertus, lībertī}.) A newcomer? (\textbf{advena, advenae}.) A young person? (\textbf{adulēscēns, adulēscentis}.) A widow? (\textbf{vidua, viduae}.) A rule? (\textbf{rēgula, rēgulae}.) A difference; a crisis? (\textbf{discrīmen, discrīminis}.) An outcome? (\textbf{ēventus, ēventūs}.) Fortune? (\textbf{fortūna, fortūnae}.) An accident? (\textbf{cāsus, cāsūs}.) Gold? (\textbf{aurum, aurī}.) Silver? (\textbf{argentum, argentī}.) Bronze; money? (\textbf{aes, aeris}.) Iron? (\textbf{ferrum, ferrī}.) The metal lead? (\textbf{plumbum, plumbī}.) Mist? (\textbf{cālīgō, cālīginis}.) A breeze? (\textbf{aura, aurae}.) A root? (\textbf{rādīx, rādīcis}.) A thorn? (\textbf{spīna, spīnae}.) A crop? (\textbf{seges, segetis}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
